description: The Marine Biogeochemistry Library (MARBL) is the ocean biogeochemistry model in CESM versions 2 and 3. It is based on BEC, the Biogeochemistry Elemental Cycle model that was in CESM version 1. MARBL simulates marine carbon, nutrient, and oxygen cycling, including a representation of the planktonic marine ecosystem (NPZD-type); in CESM3 MARBL is configured with 4 phytoplankton types and 2 zooplankton types. MARBL has riverine inputs and sediment burial of nutrients and carbon.
